action: General advice: Poste Italiane customers: be wary of emails, calls or texts that use your name, contact details or contract information; do not share credentials.
date_note: Date of the forum post: SmartWorld (19 Nov) gives 17 November; Cybersecurity360 (19 Nov) gives Tuesday 17 Nov and elsewhere 18 Nov.
exec: Customer contracts and contact details tied to a digital-signature service were reportedly leaked, raising phishing and fraud risk for customers of a major Italian provider.
plain: Poste Italiane says a data breach affected a limited number of people; reports give about 1,500 or 1,561 customers. Names, addresses, emails, phone numbers and contracts were reportedly exposed; Poste is reported to say payment credentials are safe.
summary: A Poste Italiane spokesperson, quoted by SmartWorld and Cybersecurity360, said checks continue and on first analysis the breach affects a limited number of people. Cybersecurity360 gives about 1,500 customers, attributing it to Poste; SmartWorld relays QuiFinanza's analysis of the about 1 GB of PosteCert files: 2,158 contracts and records of 1,561 customers. Exposed data include names, addresses, emails and phone numbers; Poste is reported to say payment credentials are safe.

evidence.quote: 1500 circa contro i milioni di utenti in tutta Italia
I file analizzati da Quifinanza con il supporto di un esperto informatico contengono 2.158 contratti e le anagrafiche di 1.561 clienti.

title: Poste Italiane confirms data breach affecting a limited number of customers

validation.note: Follow-up 22 Nov: SmartWorld (19 Nov) quotes a Poste spokesperson directly (checks ongoing, limited number of people on first analysis, data not sensitive to economic relations) and gives 2,158 contracts and 1,561 customers from QuiFinanza's analysis (QuiFinanza not read); forum post 17 Nov by flex22. Two publishers independently report Poste's confirmation. Earlier: Reviewer re-read Cybersecurity360 (19 Nov): limited number on first analysis; about 1,500 attributed to Poste, over 1,500 in outlet text; PosteCert is the outlet's inference; passwords and payment safe (paraphrase); forum post 17 vs 18 Nov unresolved; user flex22.
